key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: Refresh interval in seconds

key.name: open-on-hover
key.summary: Open the menu when the pointer rests on the panel button

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: Hover delay in milliseconds

key.name: panel-text
key.summary: What to show next to the panel icon

key.name: panel-graph
key.summary: Show a small live graph next to the panel icon

key.name: collapsed-sections
key.summary: Sections of the details view that are collapsed

key.name: sort-key
key.summary: How the app list is sorted

key.name: show-system-processes
key.summary: Also list processes owned by other users (root, system services)

key.name: confirm-kill
key.summary: Require a second click before ending an app or process

key.name: kill-timeout
key.summary: Seconds to wait for a clean exit before force killing

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Which part of the top bar the button sits in

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position of the button within its part of the top bar, counted from the left

key.name: panel-show-icon
key.summary: Show the icon in the top bar (always shown when there is no text)

key.name: panel-fixed-width
key.summary: Keep the top bar text from changing width as the values change

key.name: panel-graph-width
key.summary: Width of the top bar graph in pixels

key.name: panel-graph-accent
key.summary: Draw the top bar graph in the system accent color

key.name: panel-graph-color
key.summary: Top bar graph color when the accent color isn't used

key.name: cpu-alert
key.summary: Tint the top bar when total CPU use reaches this percentage (0 turns it off)

key.name: memory-alert
key.summary: Tint the top bar when memory use reaches this percentage of RAM (0 turns it off)

key.name: menu-width
key.summary: Width of the menu in pixels

key.name: show-summary
key.summary: Show the CPU, memory and load cards at the top of the list

key.name: list-category
key.summary: Which filter the list shows

key.name: hot-cpu
key.summary: Highlight an app's CPU value from this share of all CPUs

key.name: hot-memory
key.summary: Highlight an app's memory value from this share of RAM

key.name: hidden-apps
key.summary: Apps left out of the list, by name as shown or by unit name

key.name: cpu-per-core
key.summary: Show app and process CPU per core, so one busy core reads 100%

key.name: binary-units
key.summary: Show sizes in powers of 1024 (KiB, MiB, GiB)

key.name: network-bits
key.summary: Show network speeds in bits per second

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the menu

key.name: system-monitor-command
key.summary: Command run by the system monitor button (empty uses GNOME System Monitor or Resources)
